'''jbovlaste''' is a dictionary editing interface by [[Jay Kominek|Jay Kominek]], massively updated by [[Robin Lee Powell]], now in full production.

The web address is: [http://www.lojban.org/jbovlaste/ www.lojban.org/jbovlaste/]

In order to link to jbovlaste pages from pages this wiki use the following syntax when editing:
:<code>{{jvs|bridi}}</code>
This will link to the word '''bridi'''.

For editors: [http://openetherpad.org/iKLsPKqVc3 this list] tells which useful English words are yet to get a search hit in jbovlaste. The sooner the dictionary covers these words, the sooner it becomes more useful at least for English speakers.
